BiblicalUsage: Aznoth-tabor was a town on the border of Naphtali, by Mount Tabor, where the inheritance ran from the sea to the mountain. It appears once, in the drawing of the tribal borders, and then the map moves on.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God gave every tribe its borders, and even a town named once is part of the promise kept.
